'''Jok Nobah''' was a [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Formos/Legends|Formos]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He tried to rob customers with his mother, [[Mama Nobah]], while she was selling [[Water/Legends|water]].
